# Upstream LDF parser fixtures

The LDF files in this directory are copied from
[`c4deszes/ldfparser`](https://github.com/c4deszes/ldfparser) commit
`2de76f53d1d9c3be536f24d4239f6cd476e3d87a`:

- `tests/ldf/lin20.ldf`
- `tests/ldf/lin21.ldf`
- `tests/ldf/lin22.ldf`

They cover the target LIN 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2/2.2A versions. File contents are
unchanged except that a final newline was added where the upstream file omitted
one. The upstream project is distributed under the MIT License; see
`LICENSE.ldfparser` in this directory.
